title: AI Dental Receptionist: Front-Desk Voice Agent
description: AI Dental Receptionist: A production-grade voice agent platform developed during an internship at Verxeon Technologies. Features a cascaded STT → LangGraph State Machine → TTS pipeline, real-time Google Calendar integration, Chroma-based semantic RAG search, and WebRTC streaming.

title: OptiLux: Advanced Image Restoration Workspace
description: OptiLux is a professional-grade web application designed for digital image processing (DIP) and restoration. Features point processing, spatial filtering, and morphological operations with a decoupled architecture.

title: Veriflow: B2B Revenue Leakage & Invoice Auditing System
description: Veriflow: A production-oriented dual-model machine learning compliance system that flags price variances and freight overcharges using SQLite transaction history and Random Forest models.

title: Genetron: 5G Tower Placement Optimizer
description: Genetron: A spatial AI and optimization platform that leverages NSGA-II genetic algorithms and high-fidelity spectral modeling to determine mathematically optimal 5G base station placements in dense urban environments.

title: RescueAI: AI Emergency Response Platform
description: RescueAI: A bilingual (English/Urdu) AI emergency response platform for Pakistan. Features instant GPS-SOS alerts, live responder tracking, and ARIA, a real-time AI assistant for critical emergency guidance.

title: NEGO BOTS: AI-Driven Negotiation Simulator
description: NEGO BOTS: An AI-driven Negotiation Simulator bridging Human Psychology with Reinforcement Learning.

title: DeepQuery: AI-Powered SQL Intelligence & Optimization Console
description: DeepQuery: A deep learning framework that profiles SQL execution plans, predicting performance bottlenecks and ranking alternative query formulations without requiring expensive test executions.

title: ApexKV: High-Performance In-Memory Cache Engine
description: ApexKV: A high-performance in-memory cache engine built in Java. Features include TTL Scheduling, WAL Persistence, Runtime Eviction Policies, Pub/Sub Messaging, a Web Analytics Dashboard, and a TCP Server.

title: Terrag AI: AI-Powered Data Analytics Platform
description: Terrag AI: A Streamlit-based AI-powered data analytics app for intelligent insights from business datasets like customers, feedback, and sales data.

title: ThinkBoard: Data Analytics Dashboard
description: ThinkBoard: A Flask-based web application for uploading CSV files, performing statistical analysis, and visualizing data with interactive charts, featuring a modern modern layout and responsive layout.

title: Dishly: Modern Recipe Management System
description: Dishly: A modern recipe management system with pantry tracking, social features, and an admin panel, built with PHP, MySQL, and modern CSS for a responsive UI.

title: Filesystem Time Machine: File System Monitoring & OS Visualization
description: Filesystem Time Machine: A powerful file system monitoring and version control application with interactive OS concepts visualization, built with React and FastAPI.
